newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mexico's Blanco sees inflation near target - RFTV. [CORRECTED 9:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Blanco sees inflation near target - RFTV. [CORRECTED 9:55 GMT]

text.p: Mexican Trade Minister Herminio Blanco (Corrects from "Finance Minister") said on Monday that he expected inflation this year to be close to the government's 15 percent forecast.
"Inflation is coming down," Blanco, in Paris for the annual meeting of the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development, told Reuters Financial Television.
"In May we will have inflation that is already lower than one percent," he said. "The forecast is 15 percent and I think we will be very close to that forecast."
Asked about growth, he reiterated the government's growth objective. "We think the forecast of 4.5 percent will become true for the year."
